## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-1b/blob/d18cca4c121edb87d022116d281ce212c9136f57/README.md): Granite 4.0 Nano card architecture table (h-1b card): 'Sequence length 128K' for H 1B Dense. ollama lists a 1M context window. Observed 2026-10-10.</sub>

<pre>
download        size  score
8-bit q8_0    ~1.6GB   40.6
4-bit q4_k_m  ~0.9GB   40.6

```sh
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run granite4:1b-h
# 4-bit q4_k_m
llama-server -hf ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-1b-GGUF:Q4_K_M
```
